name: TheAgentCompany
summary: Benchmark of 175 professional tasks in a simulated software company (self-hosted GitLab, Plane, ownCloud, RocketChat) for agents that browse, code, run programs and talk to coworkers.
description: Self-hosted with Docker (30+ GB disk); each task is a Docker image with an encrypted evaluator. Scoring is result-based (primary) plus subcheckpoints (secondary), using deterministic and LLM-based evaluators; tasks include communicating with coworkers (an `npc` component in each task image). Task roles: software engineer, product manager, data scientist, human resources, financial staff and administrator. Paper: arXiv 2412.14161; maintainers' contacts are at CMU. Public leaderboard on the website. Release 1.0.0 (December 2024).
